map.基于国际抗癫痫联盟(ILAE)2017年分类框架，逐级确定癫痫发作分类: Based on the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) 2017 classification framework, determines seizure classification step by step
map.第一步：发作意识是否受损？: Step 1: Is consciousness impaired during the seizure?
map.强直-阵挛：全身抽搐，意识丧失: Tonic-clonic: whole-body convulsion, loss of consciousness
map.失神：短暂意识中断，无运动症状: Absence: brief interruption of consciousness, no motor symptoms
map.失张力：突然肌张力丧失: Atonic: sudden loss of muscle tone
map.继发全面性：局灶起源扩散至双侧: Secondarily generalized: focal onset spreads bilaterally
map.ILAE 2017分类取代了旧版术语（如\"简单部分性\"→\"局灶性意识保留\: The ILAE 2017 classification replaces old terminology (e.g. "simple partial" → "focal, consciousness preserved"), making classification more intuitive and clinically practical. Accurate classification is the basis for choosing anti-seizure medications (ASM): e.g. valproate suits generalized onset, carbamazepine/oxcarbazepine suit focal onset but may worsen absence/myoclonic. Note: sodium channel blockers (carbamazepine, lamotrigine monotherapy) are contraindicated in generalized onset.
map.按起病与意识进行发作类型分类。: Classify seizure type by onset and consciousness.
map.局灶性运动发作、意识受损、结构性病因：分类为局灶性运动发作（意识受损），建议头颅: Focal motor onset, consciousness impaired, structural etiology: classified as focal motor seizure (consciousness impaired); recommend 3T + hippocampal thin-slice MRI to find resectable lesion.
map.全面性非运动、失神：全面性失神发作，建议EEG 与遗传咨询。: Generalized non-motor, absence: generalized absence seizure; recommend EEG and genetic counseling.
map.先看起局灶/全面，再看意识是否受损与发作表现。: First see focal/generalized onset, then whether consciousness is impaired and the seizure manifestation.
map.结构性病完善影像，免疫性查抗体，代谢性纠紊乱，遗传性做基因。: Structural: complete imaging; immune: check antibodies; metabolic: correct disturbance; genetic: do gene testing.
map.ILAE癫痫发作分类器，基于国际抗癫痫联盟(ILAE)2017年分类框架，对癫痫: ILAE seizure classifier, based on the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE) 2017 classification framework, operationally classifies seizures by operational dimension, seizure type, epilepsy type and etiology. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
